description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named TurnPanel, which is a stateless UI component used in a Ludo game app. It displays the current player's turn, dice status, control buttons (roll, end turn, restart), and game status messages, encapsulating game turn interactions and display logic.

classes.name: TurnPanel
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the turn panel UI in the Ludo game, showing current turn information, dice, control buttons, and game messages.

classes.name: _DiceFace
classes.description: A private widget displaying the current face of the dice, with animation and styling.

classes.name: _ColorDot
classes.description: A private widget showing a small colored dot representing a player's color.

classes.name: _UiColors
classes.description: A utility class providing color mappings for different game colors.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the TurnPanel widget UI, organizing layout, buttons, and messages based on game state.
